title: Rust standup_options_from_last_command: preserve --window flags
description: rust/features/steps/standup_steps.rs standup_options_from_last_command skips --window/--lookback/--skip-weekends instead of parsing them into StandupCommandOptions. Preserve window overrides for fact-feed and report assertions.
right_now_summary: The Rust parser skips window flags, so fact-feed and report assertions lose their overrides.
